lines.en: label rinspring3:
scene sky
You know — the one I’m {i}not{/i} having sex with.
lines.zh: 你知道的——就是那个我{i}没{/i}跟她上床的。

lines.en: And while I {i}do{/i} patiently await the day that changes, now probably isn’t a good time to see if she wants to head back to her room and permanently modify our relationship.
lines.zh: 虽然我{i}确实{/i}在耐心等着那一天发生改变，但现在大概不是试探她愿不愿意回房间、把我们之间的关系永久改一改的好时机。

lines.en: I say, knowing full well that I’ve been more hesitant with her than I am with most.
lines.zh: 我这么说，心里其实清楚得很：面对她的时候，我比面对大多数人都要犹豫。

lines.en: But in a sense, Rin is kind of like the daughter I had before actually having a daughter. If you ignore the sexual tension at least.
lines.zh: 但从某种意义上说，Rin 有点像我在真正有女儿之前就已经有了的那个女儿。至少在忽略掉那股性张力的时候是这样。

lines.en: What I mean is that if we were anywhere closer to the same age, I wouldn’t hesitate to have called her a best friend in the beginning.
lines.zh: 我的意思是，要是我们年纪哪怕再接近一点，我从一开始就会毫不犹豫地称她为最好的朋友。

lines.en: Now...not so much.
lines.zh: 现在……就不太一样了。

lines.en: And we both know that. And that’s fine.
lines.zh: 这一点我们彼此都心知肚明。而那也没什么不好。

lines.en: But the lingering memory of that connection still...well, you know, {i}lingers.{/i} And I feel it most when we’re alone.
lines.zh: 但那份羁绊残留的记忆依然……嗯，你懂的，依然{i}残留着{/i}。而我们独处的时候，我感受得最清楚。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking1
That just doesn’t happen as much as it used to.
lines.zh: 只是这种时候已经不像从前那么多了。

lines.en: : The cafe? Really? You seriously thought that was a good idea?
lines.zh: : 咖啡厅？真的？你还真觉得那是个好主意？

lines.en: : You should know by now that I don’t always think things through before deciding to engage in sexual intercourse.
lines.zh: : 你现在总该知道了，我决定跟人发生性关系之前，并不总是会先想清楚。

lines.en: : Why are you calling it sexual intercourse now? Do you think formal language is going to make me any less mad at you?
lines.zh: : 你为什么现在要把它说成「性关系」？你以为用正式一点的说法，我就不会那么生你的气了？

lines.en: : Are you mad at me for endangering your livelihood? Or are you mad at me for endangering your livelihood while you weren’t around to watch?
lines.zh: : 你是气我危及了你的生计？还是气我危及你生计的时候你没能在旁边看着？

lines.en: : The {i}first{/i} one, dweeb. If I wanted to watch you bone anyone, all I’d have to do is ask.
lines.zh: : 是{i}前者{/i}，笨蛋。我要是想看你跟谁上床，开口问就行了。

lines.en: : Or hide behind a privacy curtain in the hospital room that Ayane has in her mansion for some reason.
lines.zh: : 或者躲到 Ayane 不知为什么在自家豪宅里弄的那间病房的隔帘后面。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking2
: You...knew about that?...
lines.zh: : 你……知道那件事？……

lines.en: : I may have found out after the fact. And I may have just forgotten that I was probably not supposed to tell you I knew? I can’t really remember.
lines.zh: : 我可能是事后才知道的。也可能是我忘了，我大概本来不该让你知道我知道。我真的记不清了。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking3
: Welp. There goes ever making eye contact with you again.
lines.zh: : 唉。这下我再也别想跟你对视了。

lines.en: : To be fair, it’s not {i}that{/i} much different from that night in the hotel where we listened to each other have sex in opposite rooms.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，那跟我们在酒店里隔着两间房听对方做爱的那个晚上也没{i}多大{/i}区别。

lines.en: : I guess not when you put it that way. But that was basically just me listening to Nodoka since you’re quiet as all hell when you’re hooking up with my classmates.
lines.zh: : 你这么一说倒也是。不过那基本上也就是我单方面在听 Nodoka，因为你跟我的同学搞在一起的时候安静得要命。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking4
: Also, what the hell is going on with Sana?!
lines.zh: : 还有，Sana 到底是怎么回事？！

lines.en: : Has she always been like that and just hiding it from us?! Because I am learning many things about her way too quickly and can’t even talk about most of them due to a legally-binding agreement I recently made!
lines.zh: : 她一直都是那样，只是瞒着我们而已吗？！因为我了解她的速度实在太快了，而且其中大部分我还都不能说，全因为我最近签了份有法律约束力的协议！

lines.en: : A what?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter! Sana! Horny! Yes or no?!
lines.zh: : 不重要！Sana！欲求不满！是还是不是？！

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking5
: I think she was hiding it, but...I’m not really sure. This side of her is new to me. And that time in the hospital room was the first time we ever did {i}anything,{/i} I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她之前是在藏着，但……我也不太确定。她这一面对我来说很新鲜。而且我觉得，在病房里的那次是我们第一次做{i}那种事{/i}。

lines.en: : I just wish I could remember more of it.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望自己能多记得一点。

lines.en: : That was the {i}first{/i} time? Really?
lines.zh: : 那是{i}第一次{/i}？真的？

lines.en: : Yeah. I don’t even know how it happened.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我甚至都不知道是怎么开始的。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking6
: That’s...a little concerning then. Because you weren’t really all that...{i}stable{/i} just before that happened...
lines.zh: : 那……就有点让人担心了。因为在那之前，你的状态其实不怎么……{i}稳定{/i}……

lines.en: : Did Sana maybe, like...take advantage of you?
lines.zh: : Sana 该不会是……那个……趁机占你便宜了吧？

lines.en: : She’s under five feet tall and weighs about the same as a large bag of rice. I’m not sure how much “advantage” she could take even if she wanted to.
lines.zh: : 她身高不到五英尺，体重跟一大袋米差不多。就算她想，我也不觉得她能占到多少「便宜」。

lines.en: : Maybe...it just seems kind of weird since-
lines.zh: : 也许吧……只是感觉有点奇怪，因为——

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it, Rin. All things considered, I’ve taken advantage of way more people. If she saw an opportunity and took it, good for her.
lines.zh: : 别担心这个，Rin。总的来说，我占过的便宜可比这多得多。要是她看准了机会就下手了，那也是她的本事。

lines.en: : Besides, it’s not like you had any issue with it in the moment if you were fingering yourself behind a curtain.
lines.zh: : 再说了，既然你当时躲在帘子后面自己用手，那你在那一刻显然也没什么意见。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking7
: Definitely not my proudest moment, that’s for sure...but at least I didn’t get caught having sex in a fucking cafe, you friggin’ idiot.
lines.zh: : 那绝对不是我最骄傲的时刻，这点没错……但至少我没有在一家该死的咖啡厅里做爱被人抓，你这个白痴。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking8
: Ugh! Everything’s so messed up now! Take me back to when I was a lowly coffee-slinger with a creepy teacher only boning like two girls I knew instead of fifty.
lines.zh: : 呃！现在一切都乱套了！把我送回那个我只是个地位低下的咖啡小妹的年代吧，那时只有个 creepy 的老师，跟他上床的也就我认识的两个女生，而不是五十个。

lines.en: : Do you even {i}know{/i} fifty girls? In fact, which girls {i}do{/i} you know about?
lines.zh: : 你到底认不{i}认识{/i}五十个女生？话说，你知道的都有哪些？

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking9
: Chika and Futaba for sure because I hear about it all the time.
lines.zh: : Chika 和 Futaba 肯定知道，因为我老是听人说起。

lines.en: : Futaba talks about that kind of stuff with you?
lines.zh: : Futaba 会跟你聊那种事？

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking10
: Of course. We’re practically sisters, remember?
lines.zh: : 当然。我们跟亲姐妹差不多，记得吗？

lines.en: : She doesn’t go into nearly as much {i}detail{/i} as Chika does, though.
lines.zh: : 不过她可没 Chika 讲得那么{i}详细{/i}。

lines.en: : That must be hard for you, huh?
lines.zh: : 那对你来说肯定很难熬吧？

lines.en: : You have no fucking idea.
lines.zh: : 你他妈根本想象不到。

lines.en: : Anyone else?
lines.zh: : 还有别人吗？

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking9
: Well...Sana, obviously. Nodoka, obviously. Then there’s Haruka. But they’re the only ones I know {i}for sure.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯……Sana，显然。Nodoka，显然。然后还有 Haruka。但只有这几个是我能{i}确定{/i}的。

lines.en: : Are you suspicious of anyone else?
lines.zh: : 你还怀疑谁？

lines.en: : I’m suspicious of {i}everyone{/i} else. But I’d be {i}mega{/i} shocked if you weren’t also having sex with Ayane. And probably Makoto too since those two have been riding you since day one.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑{i}所有{/i}其他人。但要是你没有同时跟 Ayane 有一腿，我一定会震惊到不行。Makoto 大概也算，因为那两个从第一天起就一直骑在你身上。

lines.en: : Both literally and figuratively. You’re right.
lines.zh: : 字面意义和比喻意义上都是。你说得对。

lines.en: : Guess that’s that, then.
lines.zh: : 那就这样吧。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking10
: Noriko? Kirin?
lines.zh: : Noriko？Kirin？

lines.en: : Noriko, no. Kirin, yes.
lines.zh: : Noriko 没有。Kirin 有。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking11
: Noriko’s a no?! Really?!
lines.zh: : Noriko 居然没有？！真的？！

lines.en: : Are you not surprised about the Kirin part?
lines.zh: : 你就一点都不惊讶 Kirin 那个部分？

lines.en: : I kind of just assume Kirin has sex with everyone, so not really. Why not Noriko? She’s head over heels for you, man.
lines.zh: : 我本来基本就默认 Kirin 跟所有人都有一腿，所以也没什么好惊讶的。为什么 Noriko 没有？她可是为你神魂颠倒啊，老兄。

lines.en: : That’s kind of {i}why.{/i} Noriko’s brilliant and driven and I feel a little weird about dragging her into the same pit of quicksand I’m dragging everyone else into. Plus, she has her own stuff going on as well.
lines.zh: : 那也恰恰是{i}原因{/i}之一。Noriko 聪明又有冲劲，把她也拖进我正把其他所有人拖进去的同一片流沙里，我总有点过意不去。再说，她自己也有自己的事要忙。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking10
: Huh...interesting. Why are you just coming out and telling me all of this, though? Is the new Sensei trying to be more honest or something?
lines.zh: : 嗯……有意思。不过你为什么突然就这么全告诉我了？是新版 Sensei 打算变得诚实一点了还是怎么的？

lines.en: : It’s more that I just don’t feel the need to hide anything from you anymore. You’ve done more than enough to keep my secrets.
lines.zh: : 与其说是这样，不如说是我已经觉得没必要再对你隐瞒什么了。你替我保守秘密，做得已经够多了。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking12
: Hell no I haven’t. I totally let the Chika stuff slip to Otoha that one time and I {i}still{/i} feel terrible about it. You’re insane for telling me literally {i}anything{/i} after that.
lines.zh: : 才怪。我有一次就把 Chika 的事失口告诉了 Otoha，我到现在{i}还{/i}觉得很过意不去。在那之后你还{i}什么都{/i}告诉我，真是疯了。

lines.en: : Maybe. But you haven’t let anything slip to Chika and {i}she’s{/i} the dangerous one.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。但你没对 Chika 漏过半点口风，而{i}她{/i}才是危险的那个。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking13

: That’s precisely why I {i}haven’t{/i} let anything slip to her. I don’t want you to end up dead in a ditch somewhere. She’s so in love with you that it’s literally crazy. Like, {i}literally{/i} crazy. Almost Ami level.
lines.zh: : 我之所以{i}没{/i}对她漏过半点口风，恰恰就是这个原因。我可不想让你哪天死在哪个沟里。她爱我爱到简直疯魔。是{i}真的{/i}疯魔。都快赶上 Ami 的级别了。

lines.en: : She’s not {i}that{/i} bad. But yeah, she can go a little overboard sometimes. Which makes me feel kind of bad since I haven’t really been spending much time with her lately.
lines.zh: : 她也没{i}那么{/i}夸张。不过话说回来，她有时候确实会有点过火。这也让我有点愧疚，毕竟我最近确实没怎么陪她。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking10
: I’m supposed to hang out with her later if you want to come.
lines.zh: : 我待会儿要跟她出去玩，你要是想一起来也行。

lines.en: : I was gonna meet up with her once my shift was over, but I left my phone at the dorm and can’t tell her that I will never have any shift ever again and am free for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 我本来打算下班就去找她的，但我把手机落在宿舍了，没法告诉她我这辈子再也不会有任何班要上、从此以后彻底自由了。

lines.en: : I’m sure the cafe will be fine. Having it closed permanently would be too huge of a plot divergence and the narrative branching would probably start to get out of hand.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定咖啡厅不会有事的。要让它永久关门，剧情偏离就太大了，叙事分支大概也会开始失控。

lines.en: : Are you boning Molly too? Because that line makes it sound like you’ve been boning Molly.
lines.zh: : 你连 Molly 也上了吗？因为你这句话听起来就像你一直在上 Molly。

lines.en: : She may or may not have put my penis in her mouth recently.
lines.zh: : 她最近大概也许可能把我的阴茎放进过她嘴里。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking14
: Good for you, Molly. You’ve finally made it.
lines.zh: : 干得漂亮，Molly。你总算熬出头了。

lines.en: : Not the reaction I was expecting, but cool.
lines.zh: : 这反应跟我预想的不太一样，不过也行。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking15

: Think you’ll ever make a choice, Sensei? Think you’ve got what it takes to just pick one of them and let the rest find someone else to fall for instead of dooming them to the life of regularly banging a gigolo?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你有一天会做出选择吗，Sensei？你觉得你有那个魄力，只挑其中一个，让其余的人去找别人来爱，而不是注定让她们过上定期跟一个小白脸上床的生活？

lines.en: : My answer to that’s a little different now than it would have been a year ago...
lines.zh: : 我现在对这件事的答案，跟一年前的答案有点不一样了……

lines.en: : I’m still rooting for Chika if that day ever does come. Sorry, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 如果真有那一天，我还是会押 Chika。抱歉了，Futaba。

lines.en: : You just don’t want me to die.
lines.zh: : 你只是不想让我死。

lines.en: : You’re not wrong.
lines.zh: : 你说得没错。

lines.en: : It’s kind of interesting how far we’ve come, isn’t it? That just a little while ago, we were both gunning for Chika’s affection.
lines.zh: : 我们走到今天这一步还挺有意思的，不是吗？就在不久之前，我们还都在争抢 Chika 的芳心。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking16
: And I was failing miserably to make her look at me while you were sticking your fingers inside of her.
lines.zh: : 而你把手指伸进她身体里的时候，我却连让她看我一眼都做不到，输得一塌糊涂。

lines.en: : And {i}now{/i} you’re encouraging me to stay with her while I’m putting my fingers inside a bunch of people.
lines.zh: : 而{i}现在{/i}，我把手指伸进一堆人的身体里，你却在劝我跟她在一起。

lines.en: : I remember when someone used to put their fingers inside of me. Those were the days.
lines.zh: : 我还记得从前有个人会把手指伸进我身体里。那可真是段好日子。

lines.en: : I could lend you a hand with that if you really need me to.
lines.zh: : 要是你真需要的话，我可以帮你一把。

lines.en: : Tempting. It might spare me the embarrassment of having to do it myself behind a curtain again. But for Chika’s sake, I will abstain. And for {i}everyone’s{/i} sake, so should you.
lines.zh: : 挺诱人的。那至少能免得我再躲在帘子后面自己动手那么丢人。但为了 Chika，我会忍住。而且为了{i}所有人{/i}，你也该忍住。

lines.en: : But what about yours?
lines.zh: : 那你自己呢？

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking17
: Don’t worry about me. I can keep using the same strategy I’ve been using ever since I first encountered the proper usage of a detachable shower-head.
lines.zh: : 别担心我。我可以继续用我一直在用的那套策略——从我第一次领悟到可拆卸花洒的正确用法开始，就没变过。

lines.en: : Guess things will just stay the same then.
lines.zh: : 那看来事情会一直这样下去咯。

lines.en: : Guess so.
lines.zh: : 看来是吧。

lines.en: : But we’re happy that way, aren’t we?
lines.zh: : 但我们这样也很开心，不是吗？

lines.en: : Are we?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking18
: I’m smiling, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 我不是在笑吗？

lines.en: : For now. But I’m sure that smile will begin to fade in twenty minutes when you meet up with Chika and she starts inevitably ranting about my penis again.
lines.zh: : 暂时是。但我敢肯定，等你二十分钟后见到 Chika，她又开始不可避免地大谈特谈我的阴茎时，那个笑容就会开始消失了。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking17
: I’ve heard so much about your penis by now that I’m starting to see it in my dreams. Can I use your phone?
lines.zh: : 关于你的阴茎我听得实在太多了，现在我都开始梦见它了。能用一下你的手机吗？

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking19
: What a strange segue. Maybe don’t repeat that to Chika.
lines.zh: : 这转折真够突兀的。这话可别跟 Chika 重复。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking20
: Sometimes I dream about your penis {i}inside{/i} of her.
lines.zh: : 有时候我还会梦见你的阴茎在她{i}里面{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure that you’re supposed to involve {i}yourself{/i} in sex dreams.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，性梦里按理说你是应该把{i}自己{/i}也算进去的。

lines.en: : Yeah, but my dreams are basically a giant cesspool of depravity now. Sometimes I’m involved. Sometimes, you’re boning Chika in my old bedroom while I’m downstairs playing checkers with my grandma.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我的梦现在基本就是一大坨堕落的污水池。有时候有我。有时候你在我以前的卧室里干 Chika，而我在楼下跟我奶奶下跳棋。

lines.en: : I don’t even know what your old bedroom looks like.
lines.zh: : 我连你以前的卧室长什么样都不知道。

lines.en: : I don’t even know what my grandma looks like. Never met her. Why is your wallpaper just Ami a million times?
lines.zh: : 我连我奶奶长什么样都不知道。从没见过她。你的壁纸为什么是 Ami 重复了一百万遍？

lines.en: : I guess because she didn’t like the picture of Makoto.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为她不太喜欢那张 Makoto 的照片吧。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking21
: What picture of Makoto?
lines.zh: : 什么 Makoto 的照片？

lines.en: : Ask her about it. I’m sure she’d love to tell you.
lines.zh: : 你自己问她去。我敢肯定她会很乐意告诉你。

lines.en: scene rinsenseiwalking22
: I’ll keep that in mind for when I go back to school on Monday. For now, I must give Chika the jumpscare of her life by calling her from your phone and pretending to be another woman.
lines.zh: : 我记住了，等我周一回学校再说。现在嘛，我得用你的手机给 Chika 打个电话，假装自己是另一个女人，给她这辈子最狠的一次惊吓。

lines.en: : Please don’t. She knows where I live.
lines.zh: : 别这样求你了。她知道我住哪儿。

lines.en: if nikinudetrade == False:
scene black
Rin gives a Chika a call and, {i}without{/i} pretending to be a mysterious lover of mine, quickly explains why she’s calling her from my phone instead of hers.
lines.zh: Rin 给 Chika 打了个电话，{i}没有{/i}假装成我的某个神秘情人，而是三言两语解释了为什么她是用我的手机而不是她自己的打过来的。

lines.en: The two of them talk for a minute or two and reaffirm whatever plans they made for this afternoon before I get roped into speaking to my “girlfriend” as well.
lines.zh: 两个人聊了一两分钟，重申了一遍她们为今天下午定下的什么计划，之后我也被拉进去跟我的「女朋友」说了几句。

lines.en: Chika does her best to try and get me to join them, but...having something else in mind, I decide it’s best to let her and Rin hang out alone instead.
lines.zh: Chika 使出浑身解数想把我拉过去一起，但……我心里另有打算，觉得还是让她和 Rin 两个人单独去玩比较好。

lines.en: I’m still not ready to be the type of person Chika needs me to be, but...that’s fine. Because she has other people who can be there for her in my place.
lines.zh: 我还没准备好成为 Chika 需要的那种人，但……那也没关系。因为她身边还有别人可以替我陪着她。

lines.en: Rin and I part ways after making it back to the dorms, but she promises to try and keep me updated on anything happening with Koi Cafe as soon as she gets an update.
lines.zh: 回到宿舍后我和 Rin 分开了，不过她答应一有 Koi Cafe 的新消息就尽量第一时间通知我。

lines.en: As I watch her disappear into the building, I feel a strange sense of relief. Relief that, even with all that’s changed as of late, what I have with her seems mostly the same.
lines.zh: 看着她消失在楼里，我心里涌起一种奇怪的释然。释然于即便最近一切都变了，我和她之间的东西看起来还是大体没变。

lines.en: And maybe things will stay that way forever. Maybe they won’t.
lines.zh: 也许这份不变会一直持续下去。也许不会。

lines.en: I’m just glad that she’s a part of my life.
lines.zh: 我只是很高兴她是我生命中的一部分。

lines.en: And I will do my very best to not get caught having sex with her boss in public anymore.
lines.zh: 还有，我会尽我所能，不再在公共场合跟她的老板做爱时被抓。

lines.zh: : 我才不管别人。我要你同时看到这个{i}和{/i}我，好让你好好想想这有多离谱。
